name: Reorder settings

intro.one: Applies to every variant of the selected product in Clear Stock. Empty fields are left as they are.
intro.other: Applies to every variant of the {{count}} selected products in Clear Stock. Empty fields are left as they are.

noSuppliers: No suppliers yet: add them in Clear Stock › Suppliers.
leadTimeHelp: Days from ordering to receiving. Overrides the supplier's lead time.
safetyHelp: Extra days of stock kept in case sales pick up or a delivery is late.
nothing: Choose a supplier, a status or enter a number first.

done.one: Updated {{count}} variant. Forecasts are being recalculated.
done.other: Updated {{count}} variants. Forecasts are being recalculated.

noneKnown: None of these products are in Clear Stock yet. They appear after the next sync.

errors.generic: Couldn't save. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: Couldn't reach Clear Stock. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalid: Check the values: lead time and safety stock are whole numbers from 0 to 365, minimum order and pack size at least 1.

minOrderHelp: The supplier's minimum order in units.
packSizeHelp: Units per case: orders are rounded up to whole packs.
discontinuedHelp: Discontinued products only sell through what is left: no order suggestions or alerts.
